title: Breath Tone Options
h1: breath tone · deeper, slower, less buzz
vars: Two notes a fifth apart pulse at 110 Hz; on a phone that is the buzz.
Same low note, its octave quietly above it. One semitone of rise, slower.
A tone and a half deeper (G).
Octave plus a quiet third harmonic, rounded off: fuller, still smooth.
T1 with the loudness rolling slowly, like a far engine.
Deeper still (F#). The phone speaker carries mostly the upper note.
